source.publication: Rhode Island Retirement Income Tax Guide, Publication 2026-01 (tax year 2025)
source.section: Instructions PDF pp.9-10, Schedule M line 1t, questions 1 and 2 and table lines 1-4; Worksheet Step 1 lines 1-7, Step 2 lines 8-13 and instructions PDF p.9, Schedule M line 1s; Guide PDF p.19, Section 5 Example #2; Instructions PDF p.4, RI-1040 lines 1-5; PDF p.5, lines 6-8; PDF p.13, Tax Computation Worksheet ('Use for all filing status types')

worked: Federal AGI = public pension (RI) (person 0) 20,000.00 + IRA distributions 20,000.00 + employer plan distributions 24,500.00 + taxable Social Security 15,000.00 = 79,500.00. Municipal interest is outside federal AGI. Federal taxable income = 79,500.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65+ = 61,750.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 79,500.00. Line 1s, Social Security worksheet: person 0 born 1953-06-15 (age 72). Line 3 federal AGI 79,500.00; line 4 Single; line 5 born on or before 03/01/1959: yes; line 6 107,000.00; line 7 79,500.00 less than 107,000.00: yes. All persons on the return qualify: line 12 = 1.0000. Line 11 taxable benefits 15,000.00; line 13 = 15,000.00 x 1.0000 = 15,000.00. Line 1t: question 1 born on or before March 1, 1959: person 0 born 1953-06-15 (age 72): yes; question 2 federal AGI 79,500.00 less than or equal to 107,000.00: yes. Table: person 0 line 2 44,500.00, line 3 lesser of that and 50,000.00 = 44,500.00; line 4 = 44,500.00. Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 59,500.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 59,500.00 = -59,500.00; RI-1040 line 2 = -59,500.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 79,500.00 + (-59,500.00) = 20,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: line 3 20,000.00 is not more than 254,250.00: the worksheets stop at line 3, full amounts. Line 4 standard deduction: 10,900.00 (Single). Line 5 = 20,000.00 - 10,900.00 = 9,100.00. Line 6 exemptions: 1 x 5,100.00 = 5,100.00. Line 7 taxable income = 9,100.00 - 5,100.00 = 4,000.00. Line 8 tax on 4,000.00 by the schedule as numbers: 4,000.00 x 0.0375 = 150.000000 = 150.00. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 150.00. Note: Guide Example #2 (Mia, 72; federal AGI 79,500). The IRA does not qualify; the state pension and 401(k) do; the Rhode Island bond interest is outside federal AGI and is not added back. Taxable Social Security is the Guide's 15,000; the gross is that figure divided by 0.85.
